report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 75ms, dependency_timeouts 0, INFO 200 logs), contradicting the alert. The only anomaly is a single gateway trace showing a 2005ms ERROR call to inventory, which is insufficient to bound a root cause. No order/inventory/redis telemetry is available, so candidates cannot be substantiated; hand off for further evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces for the order and inventory services to confirm whether the 2005ms ERROR span originates downstream of gateway
Inventory service metrics (latency, error rate, redis timeouts) for the alert window
Redis dependency telemetry to test redis-timeout as a bounded alternative
Order service metrics and logs to test db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
